result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the promotional banner uses light text on a pale green background, creating a significant readability/contrast problem.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the heading and the line 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white/very light text on a pale mint-green background, giving very low color contrast that makes the offer hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text (e.g., a deep green or near-black) or darken the banner background so the text meets WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for the smaller subtext).

issues.description: The favorite heart control is styled inconsistently: on the ramen card it is a bare white outline, while on the card below it sits inside a dark circular button, so the same action looks like two different controls.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent heart-button style (same shape, background, and icon treatment) across all restaurant cards.
